# Retained published source signatures

`grub-btrfs_4.14-2.dsc` is the unchanged signed corresponding-source description
already published with Shadowfetch 3.5.0 at:

https://www.shadowfetch.com/linux/apt/pool/main/g/grub-btrfs/grub-btrfs_4.14-2.dsc

SHA256: `922d10b8280ddca65f7b6bb08725299d68ba10c89c5ae1c16a26df2546f11a77`.

The build verifies the official release signature, exact signed description and
every generated source archive hash before reusing it. This preserves immutable
APT pool bytes when a signature timestamp is the only difference in a rebuild.
Any actual source change requires a new package version.
